report_metadata.tagline: Anticipating Detection Failures Before They Happen.

environment.hardware: Intel Core i3 11th Gen, 8 GB RAM

overall_verdict.readiness_summary: Professional 9-view dashboard finalized, integrated with real YOLO11n + ByteTrack + 27-feature + LSTM reliability outputs. Validated with 41/41 frontend tests and 100% regression pass rate.

navigation_pages.name: 📊 Overview
navigation_pages.scope: Executive operational KPIs, health scores, active job summaries, model availability

navigation_pages.name: 🎥 Video Processing
navigation_pages.scope: Asynchronous video ingestion, frame limits, 8-stage progress tracker

navigation_pages.name: 🎯 Detection & Tracking
navigation_pages.scope: YOLO11n + ByteTrack Kalman metrics, empirical continuity, frame-by-frame bbox slider

navigation_pages.name: 🔬 Feature Analytics
navigation_pages.scope: 27-dimensional feature space telemetry across visual, kinematic, and detection domains

navigation_pages.name: 🔮 Reliability Forecasting
navigation_pages.scope: PyTorch LSTM model specs, verified MSE=0.00047, multi-horizon trajectories (H1, H3, H5)

navigation_pages.name: ⚠️ Risk Assessment
navigation_pages.scope: Multi-horizon failure risk S = 1.0 - R, temporal risk trajectories, calibration matrix

navigation_pages.name: 🚨 Early Warning Alerts
navigation_pages.scope: Filterable alert incident feed, suppression & deduplication metrics, acknowledge/resolve lifecycle

navigation_pages.name: 📋 Processing History
navigation_pages.scope: Job audit log, status filtering, one-click active context, raw results.json explorer

navigation_pages.name: 🩺 System Health
navigation_pages.scope: Live backend probe latency, checkpoint verification, storage permissions, host CPU/RAM metrics

resilience_features: Granular error boundaries with retry callbacks

scientific_integrity_contracts.null_safety: Missing predictions strictly render as N/A / UNKNOWN; never coerced to LOW
